ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram, what organism is a tertiary consumer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram there are organism nodes such as Plankton, Krill, Blue Whale, Killer whale, etc.; green arrows indicate energy going from food/prey to predator/consumer. In the diagram, one chain can be seen: Plankton → Krill → Blue Whale → Killer whale. Reasoning: Plankton is the producer/base layer; Krill eats Plankton, so it is a primary consumer; Blue Whale eats Krill, so it is a secondary consumer; Killer whale eats a secondary consumer such as Blue Whale, so Killer whale is a tertiary consumer.
